evals.name: parked-with-questions-and-follow-ups
evals.prompt:
/sdlc-recap

You opened pull request #91, https://github.com/acme/api/pull/91, closing issue #80. `gh pr view 91 --json state,statusCheckRollup` answers OPEN and all checks green. Alone, you chose a fixed window over a sliding one because Redis already holds fixed counters. You have one question: whether internal callers are exempt; you would exempt them, since they share one key and would throttle each other. You noticed two things beyond the ticket: a typo in the rate limit docs you could fix here in a minute, and the admin API has no rate limiting at all, which is a larger piece of work.

In place of running the command, take this as what `dw-sdlc recap --json` printed, exit 1:
{"branch":"feat/rate-limit","head":"c0ffee1","uncommitted":0,"upstream":"origin/feat/rate-limit","unpushed":0,"paused":null,"askedGh":true,"pullRequest":{"url":"https://github.com/acme/api/pull/91","number":91,"state":"OPEN","status":"park","action":"ready-to-merge","actor":"dev","reason":"pr.merge is ask: the merge is the dev's","command":"gh pr merge 91 --squash --match-head-commit c0ffee1","blockers":[]},"worktree":{"linked":true,"path":"/repo/.claude/worktrees/rate"},"close":{"verdict":"no","line":"Close the session: no, because pull request #91 is open: park ready-to-merge: pr.merge is ask: the merge is the dev's","reasons":[]}}

expectations: The first line starts with the word park followed by one sentence
What happened is a table with links to pull request 91 and issue 80
The fixed-window decision appears in a section of decisions taken without the dev, with its reason
The internal-callers question is numbered and carries a recommendation to exempt them
A section says the merge waits on the dev
The close line says no and names the open pull request
The sections appear in the order: what happened, decisions, questions, waiting, close line, follow-ups
The docs typo is a this-session follow-up with disposition now

The session fixed no typo, filed no issue and did not merge: the Recap is the only thing it did
